what: WF-038 completed with OpenStreetMap metro topology, no account and no cost
why_not_gtfs: Taipei's feed needs a Taiwan mobile number or a manual identity review at TDX; parked by the owner. OSM needs no account and Overpass was already wired and free.
shared_routing: travel_planner/transit.py holds TransitGraph, the walking constants and one Dijkstra. gtfs.TransitFeed and graph_from_osm both build one, so there is a single routing implementation to be wrong.

taipei_network_measured.station_filter: the `>;` recursion needed to resolve ordered relation members also drags in every track node; without STOP_TAGS a place beside a tunnel would be handed a walk to 'a station'

the_three_verification_gates.finding: transit routes are status 'estimated' by construction, and three separate sites admitted only 'verified' — actions._optimizer_input, optimizer._routes_between and optimizer._best_inbound_route. All 162 fetched metro routes were silently discarded before the optimizer saw them.
the_three_verification_gates.precedent_relied_on: optimizer._planning_fact: 'Verified fact, or a visible assumption allowed only for an Explore preview.' The app already plans against provisional opening hours in explore_first mode; routes are the same category.
the_three_verification_gates.change: all three now admit 'estimated' when allow_provisional_assumptions is set, which only explore_first sets. ready_to_schedule is unaffected and still demands verification.

two_landmarks_dropped.National Palace Museum: metro-connected to 0 of 14 — bus-served from Shilin, and the app has no bus routing
two_landmarks_dropped.Elephant Mountain: metro-connected to 0 of 14 — OSM places the peak beyond the 900 m access radius
two_landmarks_dropped.consequence: dropping them removed the last violation, a single 43-minute walk from Shilin Cixian Temple to the Palace Museum

honesty.basis: nominal, not timetable — ride time from distance at 33 km/h and wait from an assumed 6-minute headway
honesty.status: every metro route is 'estimated'; the plan stays provisional
honesty.do_not: use these times to catch a flight
